raw: [Subtitle(text="Amiya?", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: Amiya?

raw: [Subtitle(text="Amiya, careful. The train's moving.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: Amiya, careful. The train's moving.

raw: [Subtitle(text="Amiya... what are you looking at?", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: Amiya... what are you looking at?

raw: The Cautus girl does not reply to you. Her body is still. Even her breathing seems to have stopped.
content: The Cautus girl does not reply to you. Her body is still. Even her breathing seems to have stopped.

raw: You can tell she's shocked. She's never let emotions as unveiled and intense show before the operators. This moment is incomparable.
content: You can tell she's shocked. She's never let emotions as unveiled and intense show before the operators. This moment is incomparable.

raw: [ImageTween(image="27_i08_2",xFrom=-50,xto=0,fadetime=1, xScaleFrom=0.9, yScaleFrom=0.9, xScaleTo=1, yScaleTo=1, ease="OutQuad", duration=20)]
At the same time, the Sarkaz chasing the train all come to a halt.
content: At the same time, the Sarkaz chasing the train all come to a halt.

raw: They all turn their heads, looking in the same direction.
content: They all turn their heads, looking in the same direction.
A Sarkaz enters the ruins.

raw: All smoke seems to part at her feet, all sounds of fire suspended about her.
content: All smoke seems to part at her feet, all sounds of fire suspended about her.

raw: Only wind remains, growing stronger and fiercer.
content: Only wind remains, growing stronger and fiercer.

raw: The ash laden on the ground is blown about, some sticking to her attire, some smudging her pale hair. She seems not to mind at all, only silently gazing into a point of the ruins.
content: The ash laden on the ground is blown about, some sticking to her attire, some smudging her pale hair. She seems not to mind at all, only silently gazing into a point of the ruins.

raw: It seems to have once been part of the defense artillery. A jet-black fowlbeast is there now, perched atop the still-warm cannon mouth.
content: It seems to have once been part of the defense artillery. A jet-black fowlbeast is there now, perched atop the still-warm cannon mouth.

raw: Most likely disturbed by the train picking up in speed, it shakes off its wings.
content: Most likely disturbed by the train picking up in speed, it shakes off its wings.

raw: As if somewhat in response, the pale-haired Sarkaz turns around.
content: As if somewhat in response, the pale-haired Sarkaz turns around.

raw: [ImageTween(image="27_i09", fadetime=0.5, xScaleFrom=1, yScaleFrom=1, xScaleTo=1.02, yScaleTo=1.02, duration=20)]
She should have no sight of who is aboard the train, but her expression is as if she has recognized who is looking at her.
content: She should have no sight of who is aboard the train, but her expression is as if she has recognized who is looking at her.

raw: Her face is so warm, yet her eyes are so filled with sorrow. The sorrow is so much; perhaps not all of it comes from her, but comes from the one who stares at her too.
content: Her face is so warm, yet her eyes are so filled with sorrow. The sorrow is so much; perhaps not all of it comes from her, but comes from the one who stares at her too.

raw: [Subtitle(text="Amiya, are you alright?", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: Amiya, are you alright?

raw: The Cautus girl finally comes back to reality.
content: The Cautus girl finally comes back to reality.

raw: She still doesn't give you a response, and you're in no rush for her to give one.
content: She still doesn't give you a response, and you're in no rush for her to give one.

raw: In one ear, you hear the calls of fowlbeasts. You see a flock of them out of the window flapping through the air, rushing into the gale ahead of you.
content: In one ear, you hear the calls of fowlbeasts. You see a flock of them out of the window flapping through the air, rushing into the gale ahead of you.

raw: [CameraShake(duration=-1, xstrength=0, ystrength=2, vibrato=2, randomness=10, fadeout=false, block=false)]
The train takes you rapidly from the station.
content: The train takes you rapidly from the station.

raw: The city wall, the war, and that pale-haired figure, all are left far, far behind you.
content: The city wall, the war, and that pale-haired figure, all are left far, far behind you.
Rumble. Rumble. Rumble.

raw: Is that the remnants of cannon fire lingering in your brain, the train bumping against the railway, or thunder in those gloomy clouds gathering not far away?
content: Is that the remnants of cannon fire lingering in your brain, the train bumping against the railway, or thunder in those gloomy clouds gathering not far away?

raw: The center of Londinium is right before you.
content: The center of Londinium is right before you.

raw: And all of you are riding into this storm.
content: And all of you are riding into this storm.
